abstract: we investigate the impact on private consumption of income-support policies, such as lump-sum transfers and withdrawals of funds from the contributors’ mandatory pension accounts. We find that both emergency income and pension withdrawals had statistically significant effects with an estimated average marginal propensity to consume of about 20 percent. Consumption of durable goods is more sensitive to these policies than other goods, especially in the programs’ initial stages. Higher educational attainment and financial leverage, proxying better access to bank credit, are associated with weaker consumption reaction across municipalities.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了收入支持政策（如一次性转移支付及从强制性养老金账户中提取资金）对私人消费的影响。我们发现，紧急收入与养老金提取均具有统计显著效应，估计的平均边际消费倾向约为20%。耐用品消费对这些政策的敏感度高于其他商品，尤其在政策实施初期。以更高教育程度和财务杠杆衡量的银行信贷获取能力更强的地区，其消费反应相对较弱。

title: The Nature of Firm Financing and Growth
title_zh: 企业融资的性质与增长
title_primary: 企业融资的性质与增长
title_secondary: The Nature of Firm Financing and Growth
authors: Martin Aragoneses, Chris Hansman, David Licher, Ramana Nanda
official: 官方在线 2026-07-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using the universe of incorporated firms in the United Kingdom, we document that long term debt that is not secured by specific corporate assets (commonly referred to as cash-flow-based debt) is ubiquitous, even among very young firms. Consistent with cash-flow-based lending depending on firms' continuation value, both the timing and the amount of cash-flow-based debt at first financing are strongly related to future performance. In fact, the age at which firms first access cash-flow-based long-term debt is a strong predictor of firm outcomes up to twenty years later. In contrast, the age at which firms access asset-based lending does not predict future performance. To understand how lending based on continuation value impacts firm dynamics, we develop a tractable theory of firm life cycle dynamics with permanent heterogeneity and financing frictions -- where access to finance can be based on signals of both current and future performance. The model highlights the importance of financing based on future value in matching the predictability of cash-flow-based financing observed in the data. It also highlights how frictions to financing based on available collateral vs. future value lead to differential selection and hence very different distributions of firms that survive and grow. The degree to which firms can access financing based on future value is therefore fundamentally intertwined with aggregate firm dynamics.
abstract_zh: 基于英国全部注册公司的数据，我们发现未以特定企业资产担保的长期债务（通常称为现金流债务）普遍存在，即便是非常年轻的企业也不例外。与现金流贷款依赖企业持续经营价值这一逻辑一致，首次融资时现金流债务的时机和规模均与未来业绩密切相关。事实上，企业首次获得现金流长期债务的年龄，能够强有力地预测其后长达二十年的经营表现。相比之下，企业首次获得资产担保贷款的年龄则无法预测未来业绩。为理解基于持续经营价值的贷款如何影响企业动态，我们构建了一个包含永久异质性和融资摩擦的企业生命周期动态理论模型——其中融资可得性可同时基于当前业绩和未来业绩的信号。该模型凸显了基于未来价值的融资在匹配数据中观察到的现金流融资可预测性方面的重要性，同时揭示了基于现有抵押品与基于未来价值的融资摩擦如何导致差异化选择，进而形成截然不同的存活与成长企业分布。因此，企业基于未来价值获取融资的能力与总体企业动态存在根本性关联。

title_secondary: How Border and Distance Effects Shape the Multinational Wage Premium
authors: Egger, Hartmut, Jahn, Elke, Kreickemeier, Udo
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Microeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: The multinational wage premium is well documented across countries. Using a new German dataset, we identify two previously overlooked determinants. First, wages paid by foreign multinationals in German plants increase with the distance between headquarters and the plant location. Second, foreign multinationals headquartered near their German plants pay lower wages than domestic multinationals, implying a negative border effect. We develop a model with plant-specific wages and firms choosing between exporting and foreign production. Distance reduces the attractiveness of exporting, making firms more willing to accept higher wages in more distant foreign locations.
abstract_zh: 跨国工资溢价在各国均有充分证据。利用德国新数据集，我们识别出两个此前被忽视的决定因素。其一，在德国工厂中，外国跨国公司支付的工资随总部与工厂所在地距离增加而上升。其二，总部靠近其德国工厂的外国跨国公司支付的工资低于国内跨国公司，这表明存在负向边界效应。我们构建了一个包含工厂特定工资及企业在出口与海外生产之间进行选择的模型。距离降低了出口的吸引力，使企业更愿意在更远的海外地点接受更高工资。

abstract_zh: 气候变化正加剧极端天气事件的频率与强度。当这些事件发生时，它们威胁着生命与生计。本文通过将家庭层面的脆弱性数据与四种类型事件（农村地区的农业干旱、洪水、热浪和热带气旋）的局部暴露度相结合，估算了全球面临气候相关灾害高风险的人口规模。在当前气候条件下，预计有45亿人将经历超过特定灾害阈值的极端事件——这些阈值旨在捕捉一生中可能发生的系统性影响。其中三分之一的人口被视为高度脆弱，这一判断基于影响其应对与恢复能力的七个维度：收入、教育、金融可及性、社会保障、饮用水、电力以及服务与市场可及性。总体而言，全球每五人中有一人被认为处于高风险状态，即他们既可能经历至少一种此类灾害，又面临严重受限的灾后恢复能力。尽管自2010年以来，由于脆弱性降低，全球高风险人口比例已近乎减半，但暴露于灾害的人口数量有所增加，且各区域的进展并不均衡。本研究基于家庭调查数据和高分辨率空间数据，引入了一项新的全球人口计数指标，用于跨国家、跨时间地监测气候风险。

title: Exploring the effects of Covid-19-policies on intra-household care work division
title_zh: 探究新冠疫情政策对家庭内部照料劳动分工的影响
title_primary: 探究新冠疫情政策对家庭内部照料劳动分工的影响
title_secondary: Exploring the effects of Covid-19-policies on intra-household care work division
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop an agent-based model to study how the Covid-19 pandemic may have affected the distribution of paid and unpaid work in families. The behavior of the agents in our model is informed by theories from psychology and sociology, as well as by economic considerations. We study two channels which were important during the pandemic: changes in time availability, resulting from an increase in unemployment and short-time work, and increased care work, triggered by the closure of kindergartens and schools, among others. Starting from a baseline scenario which is empirically calibrated with Austrian data on time use, we show that, on its own, each channel only exerts marginal post-pandemic effects. In combination, however, the model suggests that these channels promote a small, but significant egalitarian redistribution of paid and unpaid work. Social influence plays a crucial role in these results. A sensitivity analysis suggests that long-run regressive effects would also be possible, but only if the increased time availability fell to a much stronger extent on women, which seems to be empirically implausible.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个基于主体的模型，研究新冠疫情如何影响家庭中有偿与无偿工作的分配。模型中的主体行为基于心理学、社会学理论以及经济学考量。我们重点考察了疫情期间两个重要渠道：失业与短时工作增加导致的时间可用性变化，以及幼儿园和学校关闭等引发的照护工作增加。基于奥地利时间使用数据经验校准的基准情景，研究表明：单独来看，每个渠道仅产生微弱的疫情后效应；但两者结合时，模型显示这些渠道会促进有偿与无偿工作向平等主义方向发生虽小却显著的再分配。社会影响在这些结果中起关键作用。敏感性分析表明，长期倒退效应也可能出现，但前提是时间可用性增加需更大幅度地集中于女性——这在经验上似乎不具现实性。

title: Sports Betting Legalization Amplifies Emotional Cues and Intimate Partner Violence
title_zh: 体育博彩合法化加剧情绪线索与亲密伴侣暴力
title_primary: 体育博彩合法化加剧情绪线索与亲密伴侣暴力
title_secondary: Sports Betting Legalization Amplifies Emotional Cues and Intimate Partner Violence
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study explores the relationship between legalized sports gambling, unexpected emotional cues stemming from NFL home team upset losses and reported intimate partner violence (IPV). Using 1995–2022 crime data from NIBRS, replicating and extending Card and Dahl (2011)’s model, we find that legalized gambling increases the impact of upset losses on IPV by 10 percentage points. The e!ect is larger in states with mobile betting, where higher bets were placed, around paydays, and for teams on a winning streak. These results suggest that financial losses from gambling amplify emotional reactions to unexpected team losses.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了合法化体育博彩、NFL主队爆冷失利引发的意外情绪线索与亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）报告之间的关系。利用1995-2022年NIBRS犯罪数据，复制并扩展了Card和Dahl（2011）的模型，我们发现合法化博彩使爆冷失利对IPV的影响增加了10个百分点。在允许移动投注的州、投注金额较高的地区、发薪日前后以及处于连胜状态的球队中，这一效应更为显著。这些结果表明，博彩带来的经济损失放大了对球队意外失利的情绪反应。

title: Farming in crisis: Livelihood challenges and resilience in conflict-affected Sudan: Insights from the Sudan 2024 Smallholder Farmers Survey
title_zh: 危机中的农业：受冲突影响的苏丹农户生计挑战与韧性——基于2024年苏丹小农户调查的启示
title_primary: 危机中的农业：受冲突影响的苏丹农户生计挑战与韧性——基于2024年苏丹小农户调查的启示
title_secondary: Farming in crisis: Livelihood challenges and resilience in conflict-affected Sudan: Insights from the Sudan 2024 Smallholder Farmers Survey
authors: Mohamed, Shima, Kirui, Oliver K., Abushama, Hala, Siddig, Khalid, Nigus, Halefom Yigzaw 等
official: 官方在线 2026-05-12 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Sudan’s agricultural sector in 2026 is facing unprecedented challenges due to the ongoing conflict, economic instability, and climate-related shocks. These overlapping crises have severely disrupted farming activities, market systems, and rural livelihoods across the country. The situation is particularly critical for smallholder farmers, who form the backbone of Sudan’s food production and rural economy. This report assesses the state of agriculture in conflict-affected Sudan, with a focus on input use, crop production, market access, and farming household-level challenges. It draws data from the Sudan 2024 Smallholder Farmers Survey, conducted across 13 of Sudan’s 18 states. The survey covered both the 2023/24 winter cropping season and preparations for the 2024 summer season. The findings reveal that Sudan’s agriculture sector has been severely disrupted by the ongoing conflict. Migration and displacement due to the conflict are reshaping the structure of farming households, while asset losses, reduced cultivated land, and declining livestock holdings undermine their resilience. Household incomes have contracted sharply. Engagement in agricultural activities has dropped, while reliance of farming households on non-agricultural businesses, casual labor, and humanitarian assistance has increased. Food insecurity has reached alarming levels—fewer than one in four households are food secure, while over half are severely food insecure. Food-insecure households are most prevalent in conflict-affected states, such as South Kordofan, North Kordofan, and Blue Nile. However, improvements were seen in access to input and output markets and the adoption of agricultural inputs in the 2023/24 winter season compared to the 2023 summer season. Farmers reported better availability of improved seed and fertilizer and more reliable input markets and crop-selling channels. However, these gains are overshadowed by growing uncertainty—a large portion of farmers indicated that they did not plan to cultivate crops during the 2024 summer season. Farmer’s access to finance and external assistance remained highly constrained. Farming households that used credit primarily relied on informal credit sources. More than three-quarters reported receiving no external assistance in 2024. Where support is available, its distribution remains uneven, with conflict-affected areas facing severe delivery challenges. Farmers report widespread exposure to both idiosyncratic and covariate shocks such as illness, flooding, theft, and violence—all of which compound their vulnerability. The coping strategies they use include selling household goods, reducing agricultural investment, or liquidating assets. Such choices provide short-term relief but jeopardize their long-term recovery. Perceptions of insecurity remain widespread, particularly in states experiencing active conflict. Overall, the findings paint a picture of a farming sector under extreme strain in Sudan. Without urgent, state-specific, and conflict-sensitive interventions, rural livelihoods will continue to deteriorate, further threatening national food security. The report concludes with recommendations to strengthen humanitarian support, revitalize agricultural input and finance systems, protect the assets of farming households, restore markets, and invest in building the resilience of farming households to both conflict and climate risks. Tailored interventions are needed to address state-level disparities, including food and security support in the Kordofan region, water and health services in Red Sea and Kassala states, and agricultural inputs in Aj Jazirah and River Nile. Long-term strategies must also invest in climate-smart agriculture, strengthen social protection systems, and ensure conflict-sensitive approaches that protect farmers and rebuild trust in rural communities.
abstract_zh: 2026年，苏丹农业部门因持续冲突、经济不稳定和气候相关冲击面临前所未有的挑战。这些叠加危机严重扰乱了全国范围内的农业活动、市场体系和农村生计。作为苏丹粮食生产和农村经济支柱的小农户处境尤为严峻。本报告评估了受冲突影响的苏丹农业现状，重点关注投入品使用、作物生产、市场准入及农户层面的挑战。数据来源于2024年苏丹小农户调查，覆盖苏丹18个州中的13个州，调查涵盖2023/24年冬季种植季及2024年夏季种植季的准备工作。调查结果显示，苏丹农业部门因持续冲突遭受严重破坏。冲突导致的迁移和流离失所正在重塑农户结构，而资产损失、耕地面积减少及牲畜存栏量下降削弱了其恢复能力。农户收入急剧萎缩，农业活动参与率下降，而对非农经营、临时务工和人道主义援助的依赖程度上升。粮食不安全已达到警戒水平——不足四分之一的农户实现粮食安全，超过半数农户处于严重粮食不安全状态。受冲突影响的州（如南科尔多凡州、北科尔多凡州和青尼罗州）粮食不安全农户比例最高。然而，与2023年夏季相比，2023/24年冬季农户在投入品和产出品市场准入及农业投入品采用方面有所改善。农民报告称改良种子和化肥的可获得性提高，投入品市场和作物销售渠道更加可靠。但这些进展被日益增长的不确定性所掩盖——大部分农民表示未计划在2024年夏季种植作物。农民获得资金和外部援助的渠道仍严重受限。使用信贷的农户主要依赖非正规信贷来源。超过四分之三的农户报告称2024年未获得任何外部援助。即使存在援助，其分配仍不均衡，受冲突影响地区面临严重的交付挑战。农民普遍遭受特质性和协变性冲击（如疾病、洪水、盗窃和暴力），这些冲击加剧了其脆弱性。其应对策略包括出售家庭物品、减少农业投资或变卖资产。此类选择虽能提供短期缓解，但危及长期恢复。不安全感知普遍存在，尤其在持续冲突的州。总体而言，调查结果描绘了苏丹农业部门承受极端压力的图景。若无紧急、针对州情且具有冲突敏感性的干预措施，农村生计将持续恶化，进一步威胁国家粮食安全。报告最后提出建议：加强人道主义支持、振兴农业投入品和金融体系、保护农户资产、恢复市场，并投资建设农户应对冲突和气候风险的韧性。需制定针对性干预措施解决州级差异，包括科尔多凡地区的粮食与安全支持、红海州和卡萨拉州的水资源与卫生服务、杰济拉州和尼罗河州的农业投入品。长期战略必须投资气候智慧型农业、强化社会保障体系，并确保采取保护农民、重建农村社区信任的冲突敏感性方法。

title: The Power of Proximity to Coworkers
title_secondary: The Power of Proximity to Coworkers
authors: Natalia Emanuel, Emma Harrington, Amanda Pallais
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: How does proximity to coworkers affect training and productivity? We study software engineers at a Fortune 500 firm from 2019 to 2024, leveraging two shocks to proximity: (i) the office closures in 2020 and (ii) the subsequent return-to-office mandates in 2022 and 2023. In both cases, co-located teams experienced bigger changes in proximity than distributed ones, facilitating difference-in-differences designs. We find that sitting near teammates increases coding feedback by 18.3% and improves code quality. Gains are concentrated among less-tenured and younger employees, who are building human capital. However, there is a tradeoff: experienced engineers write less code when sitting near teammates. In national US data, we find evidence that the rise of remote work has had scarring effects on young college graduates. In remotable jobs, young graduates’ unemployment rate increased relative to older graduates’ post-pandemic (2022−2024) compared to pre-pandemic (2017−2019), a pattern we do not observe in non-remotable jobs.
abstract_zh: 与同事的邻近性如何影响培训与生产力？我们以2019至2024年间某《财富》500强企业的软件工程师为研究对象，利用两次邻近性冲击：（i）2020年办公室关闭，以及（ii）随后2022至2023年重返办公室的强制要求。在这两种情形下，同地办公团队比分布式团队经历了更大的邻近性变化，这为双重差分设计提供了便利。研究发现，与队友相邻而坐可使编码反馈增加18.3%，并提升代码质量。这些收益主要集中于资历较浅和较年轻的员工，他们正处于人力资本积累阶段。然而，存在一个权衡：经验丰富的工程师在邻近队友就座时编写的代码量会减少。在全美数据中，我们发现远程办公的兴起对年轻大学毕业生产生了持续影响。在可远程办公的岗位中，年轻毕业生在疫情后时期（2022-2024年）的失业率相较于疫情前（2017-2019年）高于年长毕业生，而这一模式在不可远程办公的岗位中并未出现。

title: Eviction moratoria and race disparities of eviction filing rates in the U.S
title_zh: 驱逐禁令与美国驱逐申请率的种族差异
title_primary: 驱逐禁令与美国驱逐申请率的种族差异
title_secondary: Eviction moratoria and race disparities of eviction filing rates in the U.S
abstract: During the COVID-19 pandemic, US states enacted moratoria on evictions. Leveraging detailed administrative eviction filing data, we analyse the effects of eviction moratoria on eviction filings. Depending on the specification, we estimate that eviction filings declined by 75% in moratorium states relative to states with no moratorium in effect. We then impute the race and gender of renters facing eviction. We find significant and robust reductions in filings for all groups except Asian males. We estimate that eviction moratoria reduced eviction filings for Black, Hispanic and Asian renters significantly more than white renters, and women more than men. The simplest explanation for this disparity is that non-white (female) renters are disproportionately evicted compared to white (male) renters in general, and preventing evictions in a broad, uniform manner would thus disproportionately affect these groups.
abstract_zh: 新冠疫情期间，美国各州颁布了暂停驱逐令。利用详细的行政驱逐立案数据，我们分析了暂停驱逐令对驱逐立案的影响。根据不同的模型设定，我们估算出相较于未实施暂停驱逐令的州，实施暂停驱逐令的州的驱逐立案数量下降了75%。随后，我们推断了面临驱逐的租户的种族和性别。研究发现，除亚裔男性外，所有群体的驱逐立案均出现显著且稳健的下降。我们估算，暂停驱逐令对黑人、西班牙裔和亚裔租户的驱逐立案减少幅度显著高于白人租户，对女性的减少幅度高于男性。这一差异的最简单解释是：非白人（女性）租户总体上被驱逐的比例高于白人（男性）租户，因此以广泛、统一的方式阻止驱逐行为会对这些群体产生不成比例的影响。
